answer.rationale: Primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line runs at 94% with no buffer, so switch, second-source standup, or deferral would raise delivery risk and violate the TCO-without-more-risk objective. Incumbent-side renegotiation at renewal historically recovered price and terms, and multi-year volume pricing cut unit cost without shrinking service; renewal also kept integration and deliveries intact. Intend to negotiate the expiring primary (price, payment, possible term length) rather than change the source. Verifying c4 and c6 because an 18% cut via terms is unproven; c2 onboarding speed is unused and untrusted at this utilization.
